title: Per-key hit counters using standard-library primitives
task: Implement `hits.Counter` with `Hit(key string)` and `Snapshot() map[string]int`, used from many goroutines at once; a snapshot is a copy that later hits do not change. Prefer what the standard library already gives you over building your own primitives. Tests must be exact under `-race` with a fixed number of goroutines and hits.
